prompt: gperf --pic struct-type first field type requirement
answer:
With `gperf --pic` (`-P` or `%pic`) and `--struct-type` (`-t` or `%struct-type`), the **first field of the user-defined struct must be of type `int`**, not `char *` or `const char *`.

It stores an offset into the generated string pool. Convert it to a string using:

```c
stringpool + o
```

The first field must occur first in the struct; its name defaults to `name` but can be changed with `--slot-name` (`-K`) or `%define slot-name`.
